motivation: The frozen E8 Fplus/Fminus pair is exactly n,rho,P matched at z=1100 but at z=1 has a pressure mismatch of about 1.43%. Using it directly in K01E would contaminate a hidden-state self-gravity test with an ordinary initial stress-energy difference.
purpose: Construct, before any self-gravity result, the unique closest z=1 moment-null fractional deformation to the original E8 deformation, retaining the same q-grid, FD baseline, 0.06 eV mass, and 30% pointwise cap.

construction.target_constraints: At z=1 require integral q^2 F0 r dq = integral q^2 epsilon F0 r dq = integral q^4/epsilon F0 r dq = 0.
construction.metric: Trapezoid-quadrature L2 norm of the fractional deformation r(q), i.e. minimize integral [r-r0]^2 dq.
construction.numerical_projection: Let Q be trapezoid weights and B_ij=sqrt(Q_j)*w_i(q_j,z=1)*F0(q_j). Project u0=sqrt(Q) r0 orthogonally onto null(B) using numpy SVD row-space subtraction. Row scaling may be used only for conditioning because it leaves the row space unchanged.
construction.renormalization: After projection divide r by max|r|, then set Fplus_z1=F0*(1+0.30*r), Fminus_z1=F0*(1-0.30*r).

outputs: QA JSON with z=1 moments, overlap with original E8 direction, and positivity/cap checks
diagnostic moments at z=0.95, not an acceptance criterion
interpretation: This pair is a prospective control state for K01E only. It does not replace or retroactively modify the original E8/E27 results.
